reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend (which already handles daily skipping), and factors the skipWeekend gate into applyWeekendRule shared with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The weekend-gating expression formerly inline in getUpcomingDates is extracted and shared rather than copied.

placement.why: The handler lives in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Adds the handler, its registration and tests; the only other edit is the small extraction that the new handler reuses.

maintainability.why: Short, readable handler with a named, commented window constant and focused tests covering the weekend cases.
